rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the human body part.

example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 bok3 tau4 zung6 jau5 di1 tung3

rows.note: Use this for the strip beside a road where a vehicle can stop in an emergency.

example.english: When the vehicle breaks down, it should move onto the shoulder.
example.traditional: 架車壞咗，應該駛入路肩。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 waai6 zo2 jing1 goi1 sai2 jap6 lou6 gin1

rows.note: Use this for the common pork shoulder cut sold by Hong Kong butchers.

example.english: I bought a catty of pork shoulder to braise today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 gan1 mui4 tau4 juk6 man1

rows.note: Use this for the upper slope of a mountain just below the summit.

example.english: We stopped to rest at the shoulder of the mountain.
example.traditional: 我哋行到山腰先停低抖吓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 dou3 saan1 jiu1 sin1 ting4 dai1 dau2 haa5
